techDemo.author: @EmirKarsiyakali

image.alt: Newsprint diagram — Claude on a 2007 Nokia

lesson.oneLiner: A 2007 Nokia that can’t speak modern TLS still gets Claude — firmware past Java ME into the native stack.
beats: Constraint first: TLS 1.0 + 8 MB RAM means the stock path is dead.
Reverse the firmware until the Java layer is visible and bypassable.
Drop into the native system instead of staying trapped in Java ME.
Hook a modern Claude API from that native path.
lesson.takeaway: Don’t fight the constraint — route around it. @mmmik000: This is awesome! Keep us posted.
